title: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, Efficient, and Unified Image Creation
excerpt: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, an image model in the Qwen family that balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and cost. Qwen-Image-2.1 unifies text-to-image generation and image editing in a single model, with just 7B parameters in its visual generation component and native support for generating and editing transparent images. This update introduces four key improvements

ai.why: Developers can integrate a lightweight, cost‑efficient image model for generation and editing tasks.
